title: [EN - LinkedIn] A second model checks the hard calls
content:
Your coding agent is about to guess.
Stop the guess before it lands in the repo.

Claude Code has an advisor tool.
Anthropic's docs call it experimental.
It lets the main model consult
a 2nd model at key moments.
Before it commits to an approach.
When the same error keeps coming back.
Before it declares the task done.
The advisor reads the full conversation,
including every tool call and result,
and sends guidance back.
The main model applies that guidance
before it continues.

This is not on every cloud.
The docs say the advisor needs
the Anthropic API.
It is not available on Amazon Bedrock,
Claude Platform on AWS,
Google Cloud's Agent Platform,
or Microsoft Foundry.
If a gateway sits in front of the API,
it only works when that gateway
forwards the request intact.
Claude Code also turns the advisor on
through a feature flag it fetches.
If flag fetching is off,
the docs name DISABLE_TELEMETRY
as 1 case where the advisor stays off.

Here is the part people skip.
The 2nd model is not free of rules.

You turn it on in 3 ways.
Type /advisor with no argument
and a picker opens.
Type /advisor opus to set 1 model.
Type /advisor off to turn it off.
That choice is saved as advisorModel
in your user settings.
You can set that same field in the settings file
without opening a session.
You can also launch 1 session with
claude --advisor opus
without changing the saved setting.
On a non-interactive run,
in the Agent SDK,
in the desktop app,
and over Remote Control,
passing the model or off
needs Claude Code v2.1.260 or later.
With no argument on those surfaces,
the command prints the current advisor.

The advisor must rank
at or above the main model.
The docs say Haiku 4.5 can call an advisor
and cannot act as the advisor.
Fable as the advisor needs Fable access.
On some plans, Fable bills to usage credits,
and that needs a 1-time consent.
Before you accept it,
/advisor fable does not save Fable.
The docs say it points you to /model fable.
Fable 5.1 as a model in this table
needs Claude Code v2.1.257 or later.
Do not treat a thumbnail that says
Fable is free for every account
as Anthropic's pricing page.
Read the advisor page.
Access and billing still apply.

Say you are on a subscription.
Advisor usage counts toward plan limits.
A Fable advisor is the exception
on plans where Fable bills
to usage credits.
On API billing, you pay
the advisor model's input and output rates
for those tokens,
on top of the main model.
Each advisor call reads the full transcript again.
The docs say that read is not cached.
The main model's cache stays intact
when you toggle /advisor.
You still pay for the 2nd read.

While it runs, the transcript shows
an Advising line with the model name.
If the advisor returns guidance,
the docs say press Ctrl+O to read it.
The line can also say the advisor declined,
or that the advisor is unavailable,
with an error code.
Claude generally follows the guidance.
If a recommended step fails,
or the file contradicts the advice,
the docs say Claude surfaces the conflict
instead of following it blindly.
You can ask in the prompt,
consult the advisor before you continue.
There is no setting that caps the calls.

Here's my take.
Use the advisor on a long task
where 1 bad plan wastes the afternoon.
Leave it off for a short edit.
If the page says experimental,
say EXPERIMENTAL out loud.
A 2nd model is a check,
not a receipt that the code is correct.

Follow for your daily AI update.
